Title: The fate of Mind Rape after player is ousted ?

Messages.Author: HardyRange
Messages.Body:
Hello,

couldn't find an answer to this situation that happend yesterday:

A vampire I control successfully has played Mind Rape on one of my
prey's minions.
However, before my next turn comes around, I am ousted.

I ruled that Mind Rape, as a minion card, is controlled by the player
of the vampire it is on.
Since I am out of the game, I do never get another minion phase,
therefore the condition to burn Mind Rape never triggers, and the card
just stays in play - so the poor vamp can never untap as normal for the
rest of the game.

Was this correct?

Thanks for an answer,

Hardy Range
Prince of Bochum, Germany
http://www.vekn.de
